tip: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

senses.en: whole

ex.en: The entire class passed the test.
ex.zh: 整个班级都通过了考试。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to become different, or to replace
a difference, or coins returned

ex.en: We changed the time of the meeting.
ex.zh: 我们改了开会时间。

ex.en: Cities that change bus routes without warning leave workers late and children waiting in the dark.
ex.zh: 不预先通知就更改公交线路的城市，会让工人迟到，让孩子在黑暗中等候。

tip: change 可作及物或不及物动词。

senses.en: to try to win against others
Take part in a sporting event or other contest.

ex.en: Many teams compete for the prize.
ex.zh: 许多队伍竞争这个奖项。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

senses.en: not needing others' control
not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: She became more independent at college.
ex.zh: 她上大学后更独立了。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.en: towards a lower place

ex.en: Please sit down and open your books.
ex.zh: 请坐下，把书打开。

ex.en: When a factory closes down, the town has to find new work for the people who stayed.
ex.zh: 当一家工厂倒闭时，城镇必须为留下来的人找到新的工作。

tip: down 可作副词或介词：walk down the street。

senses.en: the center of attention
the main subject receiving attention or effort
image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet

ex.en: Keep your focus on the task.
ex.zh: 把注意力集中在任务上。

ex.en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。

tip: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

senses.en: happening often
Visit a particular place regularly

ex.en: frequent rain delayed the flight.
ex.zh: 频繁的降雨延误了航班。

ex.en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
ex.zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。

tip: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: the last part of something
to finish

ex.en: Please write your name at the end of the page.
ex.zh: 请把名字写在页尾。

ex.en: The end of a holiday is a good time to ask which local shops actually benefited from the visitors.
ex.zh: 假期结束时，适合问问哪些本地店铺真正从游客那里获益。

tip: in the end 表示最终；at the end of 后面要接具体的时间或事物。

senses.en: the earth, or a particular area of activity

ex.en: Students from three countries joined the world map project.
ex.zh: 来自三个国家的学生参加了世界地图项目。

ex.en: The online world gives teenagers a voice, but it also spreads rumours faster than a classroom can correct them.
ex.zh: 网络世界给了青少年发言的机会，但谣言传播的速度也快过课堂能够纠正的速度。

tip: in the world 常与最高级连用，加强语气。

senses.en: knowing about something

ex.en: Be aware of the risks.
ex.zh: 要意识到风险。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to join together
A farm machine that harvests grain and separates the seeds.

ex.en: Good teachers combine hard work with creativity.
ex.zh: 好老师把努力与创造力结合起来。

ex.en: Cities can combine improved public transport with safer cycling routes to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市可以将公共交通改善与更安全的骑行路线建设相结合，减少对私家车的依赖。

col: combine A with B｜把A与B结合
combine theory and practice｜理论与实践相结合
tip: 动词重音在后；收割机名词读/ˈkɒmbaɪn/。

senses.en: an adult male, or humans in general

ex.en: A man from the bookshop helped us find the map.
ex.zh: 书店里的一位男士帮我们找到了那张地图。

ex.en: For most of history, man changed the land slowly; the last century has been different.
ex.zh: 在历史上的大部分时间里，人类改变土地的速度很慢；上一个世纪则不同。

tip: man 泛指人类时较少用于新的正式写作，更常见的是 humans 或 people。

senses.en: to take in; to hold one's attention

ex.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
ex.zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: how someone looks; the act of showing up
an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: First appearance can be misleading.
ex.zh: 第一印象可能具有误导性。

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。

col: improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

senses.en: an object, fact, or action

ex.en: The first thing I do is open the windows.
ex.zh: 我做的第一件事是开窗。

ex.en: The hardest thing about changing a habit is not the first day but the quiet week that follows.
ex.zh: 改变一个习惯最难的不是第一天，而是之后安静的那一周。

tip: thing 很宽泛；写作里能用更具体的名词时尽量换掉。

senses.en: the main support or reason
The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.

ex.en: Trust is the basis of friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是友谊的基础。

ex.en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。

col: form the basis of｜构成……的基础
tip: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

senses.en: any thing at all

ex.en: Is there anything I can do to help?
ex.zh: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

ex.en: If a report hides anything important, the public cannot judge whether a project deserves support.
ex.zh: 如果一份报告隐瞒了重要内容，公众就无法判断一个项目是否值得支持。

tip: anything 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句中的“某事”用 something。

senses.en: as much or as many as needed

ex.en: There is enough paper for everyone.
ex.zh: 纸够每个人用。

ex.en: It is not enough to build a cycle lane if it ends at the busiest crossing without a light.
ex.zh: 如果自行车道在最繁忙的路口没有信号灯就中断，仅仅修建它是不够的。

tip: enough 放在形容词和副词后面：old enough；放在名词前面：enough time。

senses.en: not many

ex.en: Few students finished the last question.
ex.zh: 很少有学生做完最后一题。

ex.en: A few trees on a hot street help, but they cannot replace a park.
ex.zh: 炎热街道上的几棵树有帮助，但替代不了一座公园。

tip: few 偏否定，几乎没有；a few 表示有一些。都用于可数名词。

senses.en: a title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr. Li starts the lesson at eight.
ex.zh: 李老师八点开始上课。

ex.en: A letter that begins with the wrong title, such as Mr. for a woman, can undo an otherwise polite request.
ex.zh: 一封信如果称谓用错，比如对女性用 Mr.，再礼貌的请求也会被削弱。

tip: Mr. 后接姓，不接名。书写时通常作 Mr.。

senses.en: shared customs and arts
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Food is part of local culture.
ex.zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: younger or lower in rank
Intended for younger people or involving them
A younger person, or a student below the final year

ex.en: He is a junior member of the team.
ex.zh: 他是队里的初级成员。

ex.en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
ex.zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。

tip: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

senses.en: to make it easier for someone to do something
the act of helping

ex.en: Could you help me move this desk?
ex.zh: 你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？

ex.en: Older students can help younger ones settle in, which also builds leadership in the older group.
ex.zh: 高年级学生可以帮助新生适应，这也能培养他们的领导能力。

col: help sb with｜在某方面帮助
with the help of｜在……帮助下
tip: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可以省略。

senses.en: tall, or great in amount or level

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高，我够不着。

ex.en: High housing costs near good schools can shut out the families those schools were meant to serve.
ex.zh: 好学校附近的高房价，可能把学校本应服务的家庭挡在外面。

tip: 人的个子用 tall；山、价格、水平用 high。

senses.en: the usual level or mean
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: His scores are above the average.
ex.zh: 他的分数高于平均水平。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: large in size or importance

ex.en: We need a bigger table for the group work.
ex.zh: 小组活动我们需要一张更大的桌子。

ex.en: A big sports event can fill hotels while leaving ordinary residents with higher rents.
ex.zh: 一场大型体育赛事可以住满酒店，同时让普通居民面对更高的房租。

tip: big 多用于口语；large 更中性，great 强调程度或情感。

senses.en: to have one's home, or to be alive
happening now, or alive

ex.en: We live near the old market.
ex.zh: 我们住在旧市场附近。

ex.en: People who live beside a busy road pay a health cost that does not appear on the rent receipt.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路旁的人承担着健康代价，而这不会出现在房租收据上。

tip: live 作动词读 /lɪv/；作形容词“现场的”读 /laɪv/。

senses.en: to think about carefully
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: Please consider my advice before deciding.
ex.zh: 做决定前请考虑我的建议。

ex.en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
ex.zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。

col: consider all options｜考虑所有选择
be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

senses.en: usual weather of a place
The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.

ex.en: The climate here is warm and wet.
ex.zh: 这里的气候温暖潮湿。

ex.en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
ex.zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。

tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

senses.en: a location, or a position

ex.en: This is a good place to wait for the bus.
ex.zh: 这是等公交的好地方。

ex.en: Every child needs a place to study that is safe, even if that place is a shared table.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都需要一个安全的学习地方，哪怕那只是一张共用的桌子。

tip: take place 表示发生，没有被动语态。

senses.en: to feel deep affection, or to like very much
a strong feeling of affection

ex.en: I love the smell of the library in the morning.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早晨图书馆的气味。

ex.en: People who love a place are often the first to notice when its river or dialect is disappearing.
ex.zh: 热爱一个地方的人，往往最先注意到它的河流或方言正在消失。

tip: love 后可接 doing 或 to do，口语里 doing 更常见。

senses.en: to let someone see, or to prove
a public performance or display

ex.en: Show me your ticket, please.
ex.zh: 请出示你的票。

ex.en: The data show that night markets bring noise as well as income to the streets around them.
ex.zh: 数据表明，夜市给周围街道带来收入的同时，也带来噪音。

tip: show sb sth 双宾语；过去分词是 shown。

senses.en: bravery

ex.en: It takes courage to speak in public.
ex.zh: 公开演讲需要勇气。

ex.en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。

col: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事
tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

senses.en: to protect from attack
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: Soldiers defend the city from danger.
ex.zh: 士兵们保卫城市免受危险。

ex.en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
ex.zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。

col: defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护
tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

senses.en: people watching or listening
People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: The audience clapped after the show.
ex.zh: 演出结束后观众鼓掌。

ex.en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
ex.zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。

col: reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众
tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

senses.en: to look at and understand written words

ex.en: I read the notice twice to be sure.
ex.zh: 我把通知读了两遍以确认。

ex.en: Children who read with an adult at home often arrive at school ready to enjoy longer books.
ex.zh: 在家有成年人和他们一起阅读的孩子，上学时往往已经准备好享受更长的书。

tip: read 的过去式和过去分词与原形拼写相同，但读作 /red/。

senses.en: to work out a number

ex.en: Can you calculate the total cost?
ex.zh: 你能算出总费用吗？

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: a condition, or a country or region
to say or write something clearly

ex.en: The classroom was in a tidy state after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会后教室很整洁。

ex.en: A state that invests in rural schools narrows the gap between villages and big cities.
ex.zh: 投资乡村学校的国家，会缩小乡村与大城市之间的差距。

col: in a state of｜处于……状态
tip: the United States 中的 state 是州；泛指国家时也可作 state。

senses.en: one more time

ex.en: Please read the sentence again, more slowly.
ex.zh: 请再读一遍这个句子，慢一点。

ex.en: If the same street floods again, the town should stop calling it bad luck and fix the drains.
ex.zh: 如果同一条街再次积水，城镇就不该再称之为运气不好，而应修排水系统。

tip: again 不与 repeat 叠用；repeat 本身已有“再做一次”的意思。

senses.en: a sudden serious event causing harm
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: An earthquake is a natural disaster.
ex.zh: 地震是一种自然灾害。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: the highest part or rank
highest in position or degree

ex.en: My name is at the top of the list.
ex.zh: 我的名字在名单最上面。

ex.en: Standing at the top of a test list does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 站在成绩榜顶端，并不能说明一个学生能否与他人合作。

tip: top 作形容词表示“顶级的”：top speed。

senses.en: an idea or the act of thinking
past form of think

ex.en: That is a thoughtful question.
ex.zh: 那是一个有想法的问题。

ex.en: A single thoughtless comment online can follow a student longer than the mistake that caused it.
ex.zh: 网上一句欠考虑的话，可能比引发它的那个错误跟随学生更久。

tip: thought 也是 think 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: to respect or look up to someone
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire her courage in difficult times.
ex.zh: 我钦佩她在困难时期的勇气。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: a state or requirement
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: The road is in poor condition.
ex.zh: 这条路状况很差。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: allowed by law
Allowed by the law

ex.en: Is this action legal?
ex.zh: 这个行为合法吗？

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when

ex.en: The shop is open until nine.
ex.zh: 商店营业到九点。

ex.en: A library that stays open until the last bus can serve students who cannot study at home.
ex.zh: 开到末班车的图书馆，可以服务那些无法在家学习的学生。

tip: until 可作介词或连词。not...until 表示直到……才。

senses.en: every one separately

ex.en: Each student has a different seat number.
ex.zh: 每个学生的座位号都不一样。

ex.en: Each small shop that closes on a high street takes away a place where neighbours used to talk.
ex.zh: 商业街上每关掉一家小店，就少了一个邻居们曾经聊天的地方。

tip: each of 加复数名词时，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: in opposition to, or touching

ex.en: Our team will play against Class Three.
ex.zh: 我们队将和三班比赛。

ex.en: Laws against litter only work when bins are near and people see that the rules apply to everyone.
ex.zh: 禁止乱扔垃圾的法律，只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都受约束时才有效。

tip: against 是介词，后面接名词、代词或 doing。

senses.en: strength, control, or electricity
to supply energy to a machine

ex.en: The storm cut the power for two hours.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致停电两小时。

ex.en: The power to change a bus route should sit with people who actually ride it, not only with planners.
ex.zh: 更改公交线路的权力，应该掌握在真正乘坐它的人手里，而不只是规划者。

tip: power 表示电力时不可数。作动词是“驱动”或“供电”。

senses.en: a person with special skill
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: Ask an expert for advice.
ex.zh: 向专家征求建议。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: one more, or a different one

ex.en: May I ask another question?
ex.zh: 我可以再问一个问题吗？

ex.en: Another heatwave will test whether the city's new shelters are more than a promise on paper.
ex.zh: 又一轮热浪将检验这座城市的新避暑点是否不只是纸上的承诺。

tip: another 后接单数名词；“另外两个”可以说 another two days。

senses.en: to invite someone to compete or try hard
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: This puzzle will challenge your mind.
ex.zh: 这道谜题会挑战你的思维。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: measuring a great length or time
to want something very much

ex.en: It was a long walk from the station.
ex.zh: 从车站走过来要很久。

ex.en: A long commute can take away the evening hours that students need for sleep and reading.
ex.zh: 漫长的通勤会占去学生需要用于睡觉和阅读的晚上时间。

tip: how long 询问时间或长度。long 作动词是“渴望”。

senses.en: from one side to the other, or by means of

ex.en: We walked through the market on the way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家时穿过了市场。

ex.en: Students learn more through explaining an idea than through reading the same note again.
ex.zh: 学生通过讲解一个想法学到的，往往多于把同一条笔记再读一遍。

tip: through 强调从内部穿过；across 强调从表面一边到另一边。

senses.en: a problem
A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: She overcame great difficulty to succeed.
ex.zh: 她克服巨大困难获得成功。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.en: having lived long, or not new

ex.en: This is an old map, but the river is the same.
ex.zh: 这是一张旧地图，但那条河还是一样的。

ex.en: Old buildings can teach a city what to keep when everything else is being rebuilt.
ex.zh: 当其他一切都在重建时，老建筑可以告诉一座城市该保留什么。

tip: 表示年龄用数字加 years old。兄姐用 elder 或 older 都可以。

senses.en: a period of seven days

ex.en: We have a test next week.
ex.zh: 我们下周有一次测验。

ex.en: A four-day school week may cut costs, but it can also lengthen each remaining day beyond what children can manage.
ex.zh: 每周上四天课也许能省钱，但也可能把剩下的每天拉长到孩子承受不了。

tip: next week 前不加 the。

senses.en: to have inside
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This box may contain old letters.
ex.zh: 这个盒子里可能装有旧信。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: before noon

ex.en: The reading room opens at 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 阅览室早上七点开门。

ex.en: Starting lessons at 7 a.m. may suit adults, but many teenagers are still at their sleepiest then.
ex.zh: 早上七点上课也许适合成年人，但许多青少年那时仍处于最困的时候。

tip: a.m. 表示午夜到中午；书写时数字与 a.m. 之间留空格。

senses.en: parents and children, or relatives

ex.en: My family has dinner together on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们家周日一起吃晚饭。

ex.en: When housing is too expensive, a family may spend so much on rent that little remains for books or clinics.
ex.zh: 当住房太贵时，一个家庭可能把太多钱花在房租上，书籍和看病就所剩无几。

tip: family 作整体时谓语用单数；强调家庭成员时有时用复数。

senses.en: to take to a place; to give a speech
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The post office will deliver the package.
ex.zh: 邮局会递送这个包裹。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: coins and notes used to buy things

ex.en: I do not have enough money for two tickets.
ex.zh: 我的钱不够买两张票。

ex.en: Money spent on early reading support can reduce the cost of failure later in secondary school.
ex.zh: 花在早期阅读辅导上的钱，可以减少中学阶段失败带来的后续成本。

tip: money 不可数，不说 moneys 或 a money。

senses.en: something successfully done
The successful completion of a goal through effort.

ex.en: Winning the prize was a great achievement.
ex.zh: 获奖是一项巨大成就。

ex.en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。

col: the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

senses.en: actually existing, or genuine

ex.en: Is this a real diamond or a glass one?
ex.zh: 这是真钻石还是玻璃的？

ex.en: Real progress on air quality is measured in hospital visits, not only in official announcements.
ex.zh: 空气质量的真正进步要用就诊人数来衡量，而不只是官方通报。

tip: real 强调实际存在；true 强调与事实相符。

senses.en: a person who is not named

ex.en: Someone left a notebook on the piano.
ex.zh: 有人把笔记本落在钢琴上了。

ex.en: Someone has to decide which bus routes stay open when a city cannot fund them all.
ex.zh: 当一座城市无法资助所有公交线路时，必须有人决定哪些线路继续开。

tip: someone 后面的形容词要后置：someone important。

senses.en: used to make a request polite
to make someone happy

ex.en: Please close the window before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前请把窗户关上。

ex.en: Signs that say please are not enough if the bins are too far from where people finish their food.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离人们吃完东西的地方太远，写着“请”的标牌是不够的。

tip: please 可放在句首或句末。pleased 表示人感到高兴。

senses.en: difficult, solid, or needing effort
with a lot of effort

ex.en: This question is hard, but not impossible.
ex.zh: 这道题难，但不是做不出。

ex.en: Hard plastic that cannot be repaired becomes waste faster than a simple tool made of wood.
ex.zh: 无法修理的硬塑料，会比一件简单的木制工具更快变成垃圾。

tip: hard 可以是“努力地”；hardly 是否定副词“几乎不”，二者完全不同。

senses.en: to experience a feeling or opinion

ex.en: I feel nervous before I speak in class.
ex.zh: 我在课堂上发言前感到紧张。

ex.en: Residents feel the effect of a new airport long before the official noise report is published.
ex.zh: 居民在官方噪音报告公布之前很久，就能感到新机场的影响。

tip: feel 作连系动词，后面接形容词：feel tired，不接 tiredly。

senses.en: an activity with rules, often for fun or sport

ex.en: Our class won the basketball game.
ex.zh: 我们班赢了篮球赛。

ex.en: A game that rewards only speed may discourage students who think carefully but slowly.
ex.zh: 只奖励速度的游戏，可能会让思考仔细但较慢的学生失去信心。

tip: game 可指一场比赛；match 更常用于正式体育赛事。

senses.en: to make sure something is true
To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

ex.en: Please confirm your email address.
ex.zh: 请确认你的电子邮箱地址。

ex.en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。

tip: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。

senses.en: a formal request; a use
the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods
a computer program designed to perform particular tasks

ex.en: Send your application before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前递交你的申请。

ex.en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
ex.zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。

tip: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

senses.en: a group working or playing together

ex.en: Our team practises on Wednesday evenings.
ex.zh: 我们队周三晚上训练。

ex.en: A rescue team is only as fast as the roads and phone signals that connect it to a village.
ex.zh: 救援队的速度，取决于连接它和村庄的道路与手机信号。

tip: team 作整体时谓语可用单数；强调成员时可用复数。

senses.en: a human being

ex.en: She is the right person to ask about the map.
ex.zh: 问地图的事，她是合适的人。

ex.en: A person who cannot afford the bus may never see the museum the city is proud of.
ex.zh: 付不起公交费的人，可能永远看不到这座城市引以为傲的博物馆。

tip: person 的复数通常是 people，不常说 persons。

senses.en: all things

ex.en: Everything is ready for the open day.
ex.zh: 开放日的一切都准备好了。

ex.en: A school cannot control everything a child sees online, so it should teach how to pause and check.
ex.zh: 学校无法控制孩子在网上看到的一切，所以应该教他们如何停下来核对。

tip: everything 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: lack of success
a situation in which a machine or organ stops working
not doing something that is expected or required

ex.en: failure can teach useful lessons.
ex.zh: 失败能教会有用的功课。

ex.en: Schools should treat failure as an opportunity for learning rather than as evidence of a student's limited ability.
ex.zh: 学校应将失败视为学习的机会，而不是学生能力有限的证明。

tip: 泛指失败通常不可数；a failure可指失败的事物。

senses.en: to move towards the speaker or a place

ex.en: Come to the hall when you hear the bell.
ex.zh: 听到铃声就到大厅来。

ex.en: New businesses come to a town only when roads, power, and schools are already reliable.
ex.zh: 只有当道路、电力和学校已经可靠时，新的商家才会来到一个城镇。

tip: come 的过去式是 came，过去分词是 come。

senses.en: below, or less than

ex.en: The cat is sleeping under the desk.
ex.zh: 猫在书桌下睡觉。

ex.en: Children under six need shorter lessons and more time to move than a standard timetable allows.
ex.zh: 六岁以下的孩子需要比标准课表更短的课和更多活动时间。

tip: under 可表示在下方，也可表示少于某个年龄或数量。

senses.en: to speak words

ex.en: What did the coach say after the match?
ex.zh: 比赛后教练说了什么？

ex.en: Experts say that planting trees without caring for them later wastes both money and land.
ex.zh: 专家说，种了树却不后续养护，会同时浪费金钱和土地。

col: that is to say｜也就是说
tip: say 强调说的内容；tell 后面常接人：tell sb sth。

senses.en: a large amount, or a piece of land

ex.en: A lot of students take the early bus.
ex.zh: 很多学生乘早班车。

ex.en: A parking lot on a former playground shows what a school gives up when space becomes expensive.
ex.zh: 原来的操场变成停车场，说明当空间变贵时，学校放弃了什么。

tip: a lot of 既可接可数也可接不可数；too much 只接不可数。

senses.en: to draw interest
Pull something closer through a physical force

ex.en: Bright colors attract many insects.
ex.zh: 鲜艳的颜色吸引许多昆虫。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。

tip: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

senses.en: to annoy or trouble
to make the effort to do something
trouble or effort that causes inconvenience

ex.en: Sorry to bother you so late.
ex.zh: 很抱歉这么晚打扰你。

ex.en: Constant notifications can bother students during lessons and reduce their ability to concentrate on complex tasks.
ex.zh: 持续不断的通知会在课堂上干扰学生，降低他们专注于复杂任务的能力。

col: bother someone with something｜拿某事打扰某人
bother to do something｜费心做某事
a lot of bother｜很多麻烦
tip: bother to do常用于否定或疑问，表示费心做。

senses.en: to discover something, often after looking

ex.en: I cannot find my student card.
ex.zh: 我找不到学生卡了。

ex.en: Scientists sometimes find that a cheap local method works better than an imported machine.
ex.zh: 科学家有时发现，便宜的本地方法比进口机器更有效。

tip: find 的过去式和过去分词是 found，不是 finded。

senses.en: to be unlike
To have a different opinion from another person.

ex.en: Opinions may differ among friends.
ex.zh: 朋友之间意见可能不同。

ex.en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
ex.zh: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。

col: differ with someone｜与某人意见不同
tip: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

senses.en: not detailed; overall
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: In general, people prefer weekends.
ex.zh: 一般来说，人们更喜欢周末。

ex.en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
ex.zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

senses.en: to say someone is responsible for a fault
Responsibility for something bad that has happened.

ex.en: Don't blame others for your mistakes.
ex.zh: 不要把自己的错误归咎于别人。

ex.en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
ex.zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

col: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人
blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人
tip: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

senses.en: to direct one's eyes, or to seem

ex.en: Look at the diagram before you answer.
ex.zh: 回答之前先看图。

ex.en: Streets that look beautiful in photos may still be unsafe if there is nowhere to cross.
ex.zh: 在照片里好看的街道，如果没有地方过马路，仍然可能不安全。

tip: look forward to 后面接名词或 doing。look 是看的动作，see 是看见。

senses.en: a member of a country
A person who lives in a particular town or city.

ex.en: Every citizen has rights and duties.
ex.zh: 每个公民都有权利与义务。

ex.en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。

col: a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

senses.en: certain, or reliable

ex.en: Are you sure this is your bag?
ex.zh: 你确定这是你的包吗？

ex.en: Leaders should not be sure a policy works until they have asked the people who live with it.
ex.zh: 领导者在询问真正生活在政策之下的人之前，不应确信政策有效。

tip: be sure to do 提醒某人一定要做；make sure 后面常接 that 从句。

senses.en: the place where one lives

ex.en: I left my keys at home.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在家里了。

ex.en: A city that offers only expensive flats cannot call itself a home for the nurses and drivers it needs.
ex.zh: 一座只提供昂贵公寓的城市，无法成为它所需的护士和司机的家。

tip: home 前通常不加 to：go home，不是 go to home。

senses.en: before now, or sooner than expected

ex.en: I have already handed in the form.
ex.zh: 我已经交了表格。

ex.en: By the time a warning is issued, the river may already have risen over the path to school.
ex.zh: 等到警报发出时，河水可能已经漫过上学的小路。

tip: already 多用于肯定句；否定和疑问里表示“尚未”常用 yet。

senses.en: to feel that something is important
attention or looking after someone

ex.en: She cares about every student in the class.
ex.zh: 她关心班上的每一个学生。

ex.en: People care more about a park when they helped plant the trees than when they only walk past it.
ex.zh: 人们如果参与种过树，会比只是路过时更在意一座公园。

tip: care for 可以是照顾，也可以是“喜欢”，要看语境。

senses.en: coming immediately after

ex.en: The next bus leaves in ten minutes.
ex.zh: 下一班车十分钟后开。

ex.en: The next step after collecting data is to ask whether the sample left anyone out.
ex.zh: 收集数据之后的下一步，是追问样本是否漏掉了什么人。

tip: next week 前不加 the；the next week 常指过去某个时间之后的一周。

senses.en: personality; a person in a story
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Honesty is part of his character.
ex.zh: 诚实是他性格的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.en: to or at a distance

ex.en: She put the phone away during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭时她把手机收起来了。

ex.en: Moving factories away from rivers can protect drinking water for the towns downstream.
ex.zh: 把工厂迁离河流，可以保护下游城镇的饮用水。

tip: away 是副词，不单独接宾语；表示离开某地用 away from。

senses.en: a number; an important person
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: The figure on the board is wrong.
ex.zh: 黑板上的数字错了。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: to succeed in doing something

ex.en: He worked hard to achieve his goals.
ex.zh: 他努力工作以实现目标。

ex.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: a usual practice
made to meet a particular customer's needs
the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Shaking hands is a common custom.
ex.zh: 握手是一种常见习俗。

ex.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

senses.en: to hand something to someone, or to provide

ex.en: Please give the form to your class teacher.
ex.zh: 请把表格交给班主任。

ex.en: Cities that give buses their own lanes often move more people than cities that only widen roads.
ex.zh: 给公交车专用车道的城市，往往比只拓宽马路的城市运送更多人。

tip: give sb sth 或 give sth to sb，两种语序都可以。

senses.en: very good, important, or large

ex.en: We had a great time at the school fair.
ex.zh: 我们在校园义卖上玩得很开心。

ex.en: A great increase in visitors can damage the very places people travel to see.
ex.zh: 游客的大量增加，可能破坏人们专程去看的那些地方。

tip: a great many 后接可数名词复数。

senses.en: belonging to the person mentioned
to possess

ex.en: I wrote the speech in my own words.
ex.zh: 我用自己的话写了这篇演讲。

ex.en: A town that grows its own vegetables is less shaken when outside supplies are delayed.
ex.zh: 自己种菜的城镇，在外部供应延误时受到的冲击更小。

tip: own 前要有物主代词：my own，不能单独说 own book。

senses.en: the two together

ex.en: Both answers are possible.
ex.zh: 两个答案都有可能。

ex.en: A city needs both affordable housing and good schools if it wants families to stay.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市希望家庭留下来，就既需要付得起的住房，也需要好学校。

tip: both...and... 连接并列成分，谓语用复数。

senses.en: willing to give
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: She is generous with her time.
ex.zh: 她在时间上很大方。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: not different

ex.en: We took the same bus home.
ex.zh: 我们乘了同一班车回家。

ex.en: Two schools can follow the same timetable and still offer very different support to struggling students.
ex.zh: 两所学校可以执行同样的课表，但对学习吃力的学生提供的帮助仍然很不一样。

tip: same 前面通常加 the。

senses.en: the feeling of a place; air around Earth
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: The classroom had a friendly atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教室里气氛友好。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: throughout a period of time

ex.en: Please do not talk during the exam.
ex.zh: 考试期间请不要说话。

ex.en: During a drought, schools can show families how small daily changes save a surprising amount of water.
ex.zh: 干旱期间，学校可以向家庭展示，日常的小改变能省下惊人的水量。

tip: during 后接名词，不接句子；接句子用 while 或 when。

senses.en: not boastful; not large
not large in size, amount, or cost
wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body

ex.en: She is modest about her success.
ex.zh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚。

ex.en: Even a modest increase in public transport funding could improve services in rural communities.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通拨款只小幅增加，也可能改善农村社区的服务。

col: modest about one's achievements｜对自己的成就谦虚
tip: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。

senses.en: facts that prove something
To show clearly that something exists or is true.

ex.en: There is no evidence of cheating.
ex.zh: 没有作弊的证据。

ex.en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
ex.zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

tip: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

senses.en: a way of dealing with something
To move nearer to someone or something.
To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.

ex.en: A new approach may solve the problem.
ex.zh: 新方法可能解决这个问题。

ex.en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
ex.zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。

col: an approach to learning｜学习方法
adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
approach a problem｜着手处理问题
approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
tip: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

senses.en: about right and wrong
a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story

ex.en: The story has a moral lesson.
ex.zh: 这个故事有道德寓意。

ex.en: Companies have a moral responsibility to ensure that their suppliers provide safe working conditions.
ex.zh: 企业在道义上有责任确保其供应商提供安全的工作环境。

col: the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: to carry out; to lead
to allow heat or electricity to pass through
the way a person behaves, especially towards others

ex.en: Scientists conduct experiments in the lab.
ex.zh: 科学家在实验室进行实验。

ex.en: Researchers should conduct thorough trials before recommending new treatments for widespread use in public hospitals.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议公立医院广泛采用新疗法之前，应开展充分的试验。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

senses.en: to discuss opposing views
To discuss a subject by considering different views.
To think carefully about options before making a decision.

ex.en: Students will debate the topic in class.
ex.zh: 学生们将在课堂上辩论这个话题。

ex.en: The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.
ex.zh: 关于免费公共交通的争论集中在其环境效益和纳税人需要承担的费用上。

col: debate an issue｜讨论一个问题
tip: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

senses.en: helpful

ex.en: Walking is beneficial to health.
ex.zh: 散步有益健康。

ex.en: Access to green spaces is particularly beneficial to urban residents who have limited opportunities for outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 对于户外锻炼机会有限的城市居民来说，能够使用绿地尤其有益。

tip: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

senses.en: a line that marks a limit
A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something

ex.en: Respect personal boundary at work.
ex.zh: 在工作中尊重个人界限。

ex.en: Clear boundaries between work and personal life can protect employees' mental health and reduce long-term stress.
ex.zh: 明确工作与个人生活的界限，可以保护员工的心理健康并减轻长期压力。

tip: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

senses.en: to try
To try to do something, especially something difficult.

ex.en: She will attempt to climb the mountain.
ex.zh: 她将尝试爬山。

ex.en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
ex.zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。

col: attempt to do something｜尝试做某事
in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

senses.en: worried; eager
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: She felt anxious before the test.
ex.zh: 考试前她感到焦虑。

ex.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
ex.zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: to give time or energy to

ex.en: She will devote more time to study.
ex.zh: 她将把更多时间用于学习。

ex.en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。

tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to change to fit a new situation
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Animals must adapt to climate change.
ex.zh: 动物必须适应气候变化。

ex.en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

col: adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法
adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

senses.en: previous
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: He is a former student of this school.
ex.zh: 他是这所学校以前的学生。

ex.en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
ex.zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

col: former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

senses.en: easy to see or understand

ex.en: It is evident that she studied hard.
ex.zh: 很明显她学习很努力。

ex.en: The benefits of improved public transport are evident in cities where traffic congestion has decreased.
ex.zh: 在交通拥堵有所缓解的城市，改善公共交通的益处显而易见。

tip: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

senses.en: enough

ex.en: Food supply is adequate.
ex.zh: 食物供应是足够的。

ex.en: Schools need adequate funding to maintain safe buildings and provide effective support for students with additional needs.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来保障校舍安全，并为有额外需求的学生提供有效支持。

col: adequate for the task｜足以胜任任务
tip: 表示达到所需标准，不等于优秀；常接for或to。

senses.en: real

ex.en: The actual cost was higher.
ex.zh: 实际费用更高。

ex.en: Governments should measure the actual impact of transport policies rather than relying solely on predicted benefits.
ex.zh: 政府应衡量交通政策的实际影响，而不是仅仅依赖预期收益。

tip: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

senses.en: easy to see; seeming
Seeming to be true, though possibly not actually true.

ex.en: It was apparent that he was tired.
ex.zh: 很明显他累了。

ex.en: Despite the apparent benefits of remote learning, some students struggle without direct support from teachers.
ex.zh: 尽管远程学习看似有诸多好处，一些学生在缺乏教师直接帮助时仍感到吃力。

col: for no apparent reason｜无明显原因
tip: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

senses.en: happening slowly
Rising or falling gently rather than steeply

ex.en: Progress is often gradual.
ex.zh: 进步往往是逐渐的。

ex.en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
ex.zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。

tip: 强调变化缓慢、分阶段；副词形式为gradually。

senses.en: to suppose; to take on
To take on a duty, responsibility, or position.
To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.

ex.en: Don't assume that everyone knows the rules.
ex.zh: 不要假定人人都知道规则。

ex.en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。

tip: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

senses.en: to take up; to take as one's own
To legally take someone else's child into your family.
To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.

ex.en: The school will adopt a new teaching method.
ex.zh: 学校将采用一种新的教学方法。

ex.en: Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
ex.zh: 政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。

col: adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
adopt a policy｜采纳一项政策
tip: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

senses.en: power to make decisions
an official body responsible for a particular area or service
a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject

ex.en: The school authority made a new rule.
ex.zh: 学校当局制定了新规则。

ex.en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
ex.zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。

col: have authority to do something｜有权做某事
an authority on｜某方面的权威
tip: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

senses.en: something given to help
Money or goods given to support a person or cause.
A piece of writing supplied for a publication.

ex.en: His contribution to science was huge.
ex.zh: 他对科学的贡献巨大。

ex.en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。

col: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献
tip: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to value or be thankful for
Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something.
Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.

ex.en: I really appreciate your help.
ex.zh: 我真心感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
ex.zh: 政策制定者需要理解农村社区在获取医疗及其他基本服务时面临的困难。

col: appreciate your help｜感谢你的帮助
appreciate the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

senses.en: correct and exact
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: Give an accurate answer, please.
ex.zh: 请给出准确答案。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.en: the right to act freely
The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.

ex.en: Speech freedom is valued in many places.
ex.zh: 许多地方重视言论自由。

ex.en: Universities should protect academic freedom while encouraging researchers to consider the social consequences of their work.
ex.zh: 大学应保护学术自由，同时鼓励研究人员考虑其工作的社会影响。

tip: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

senses.en: basic and important
A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.

ex.en: Honesty is a fundamental value.
ex.zh: 诚实是基本价值观。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental requirement for improving public health in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水是改善弱势社区公共卫生的基本条件。

tip: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

senses.en: a matter or event
a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner

ex.en: Public affair need careful attention.
ex.zh: 公共事务需要认真关注。

ex.en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。

tip: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

senses.en: first
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

ex.en: My initial plan was wrong.
ex.zh: 我最初的计划是错的。

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
ex.zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

senses.en: to state officially
to officially report goods, income or other required information

ex.en: The mayor will declare the festival open.
ex.zh: 市长将宣布节日开幕。

ex.en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。

col: declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态
tip: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

senses.en: facts and figures

ex.en: Scientists collect data from tests.
ex.zh: 科学家从实验中收集数据。

ex.en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

tip: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

senses.en: a condition around an event
the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation

ex.en: Under no circumstance should you lie.
ex.zh: 在任何情况下你都不该说谎。

ex.en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
ex.zh: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。

col: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下
tip: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

senses.en: fine; easily broken
Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence.
Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.

ex.en: Handle the glass with delicate care.
ex.zh: 轻拿轻放这些玻璃。

ex.en: Tourism in coastal regions must be carefully managed to protect delicate ecosystems from lasting damage.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的旅游业必须得到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的生态系统免遭长期破坏。

col: delicate negotiations｜需谨慎进行的谈判
tip: 既可形容易损物品，也可形容需谨慎处理的问题。

senses.en: to tell apart
to make someone or something different from others
to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it

ex.en: Babies learn to distinguish colors early.
ex.zh: 婴儿很早就能学会辨别颜色。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish reliable evidence from personal opinion when evaluating information online.
ex.zh: 学生在评估网络信息时，应学会区分可靠证据与个人观点。

col: distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开
tip: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

senses.en: able to change easily
able to bend easily without breaking

ex.en: Keep a flexible schedule.
ex.zh: 保持灵活的时间安排。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。

col: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间
tip: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

senses.en: a feeling of worry

ex.en: Exam anxiety is common among students.
ex.zh: 考试焦虑在学生中很常见。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。

tip: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

senses.en: a serious disagreement
A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree.
To disagree with or be incompatible with something.

ex.en: Talking can reduce family conflict.
ex.zh: 沟通可以减少家庭冲突。

ex.en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。

col: a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: to send out by radio or TV
A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The match will broadcast live tonight.
ex.zh: 比赛今晚将直播。

ex.en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
ex.zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

senses.en: the purpose of something
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: What is the function of this button?
ex.zh: 这个按钮的功能是什么？

ex.en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
ex.zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: a worry or interest

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
senses.en: An issue that matters or causes worry
To relate to someone or something, or cause worry

ex.en: Health is a shared concern for all.
ex.zh: 健康是所有人共同的关切。

ex.en: Growing concern about air pollution has encouraged many cities to invest in cleaner public transport systems.
ex.zh: 人们对空气污染日益担忧，促使许多城市投资建设更清洁的公共交通系统。

col: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧
a major concern｜一个主要问题
concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

senses.en: the state of being away
a situation in which something does not exist or occur

ex.en: His absence from class worried the teacher.
ex.zh: 他缺课让老师担心。

ex.en: In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
ex.zh: 在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。

col: in someone's absence｜在某人不在时
in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下
tip: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

senses.en: happening all the time
remaining the same over time
a value or quantity that does not change

ex.en: There is constant noise from the street.
ex.zh: 街上有持续的噪音。

ex.en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑保持恒温可以提高舒适度，但可能增加能源消耗。

tip: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

senses.en: made by people, not natural
Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour

ex.en: artificial light can hurt sleep.
ex.zh: 人造光可能影响睡眠。

ex.en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
ex.zh: 城市中过量的人工照明会扰乱野生动物的行为，并使星星难以看清。

tip: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

senses.en: to give out
to spread something over an area

ex.en: Volunteers distribute food to the poor.
ex.zh: 志愿者向穷人分发食物。

ex.en: Governments must distribute healthcare resources fairly so that rural communities receive the same quality of care as urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府必须公平分配医疗资源，让农村社区享有与城市居民同等质量的医疗服务。

tip: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

senses.en: to give for a purpose
To help cause a particular result
To write material for a publication or website

ex.en: Everyone can contribute to the project.
ex.zh: 每个人都能为这个项目做贡献。

ex.en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
ex.zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。

col: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论
contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长
tip: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: total; complete
not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities

ex.en: He has absolute confidence in the team.
ex.zh: 他对团队有绝对信心。

ex.en: Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
ex.zh: 赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。

col: an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

senses.en: to decide firmly; to find out
To control or strongly influence what happens.
To make a firm decision to do something.

ex.en: Tests help determine your progress.
ex.zh: 测试有助于测定你的进步。

ex.en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
ex.zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。

tip: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

senses.en: not guilty; pure
Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life.
Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.

ex.en: The child looked innocent.
ex.zh: 孩子看上去很天真。

ex.en: A fair legal system must protect innocent people while ensuring that those responsible for crimes face justice.
ex.zh: 公平的法律制度必须保护无辜者，同时确保犯罪者受到法律制裁。

col: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪
tip: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

senses.en: suitable
to take something for your own use without permission
to officially set aside money for a particular purpose

ex.en: Wear appropriate clothes for the interview.
ex.zh: 面试穿合适的衣服。

ex.en: Governments should provide appropriate training to help workers adapt to technological changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 政府应提供适当培训，帮助劳动者适应劳动力市场中的技术变革。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词读/eɪt/。

senses.en: ease of use
Something that makes daily life easier.

ex.en: Online shopping offers great convenience.
ex.zh: 网购提供极大便利。

ex.en: Although online shopping offers convenience, it may encourage unnecessary spending and increase packaging waste.
ex.zh: 虽然网上购物带来了便利，但它可能助长不必要的消费，并增加包装垃圾。

tip: 表示“方便”通常不可数；形容词是convenient。

senses.en: a result of an action
The quality of being important or worth considering.

ex.en: Every choice has a consequence.
ex.zh: 每个选择都有后果。

ex.en: One serious consequence of rapid urban growth is increased pressure on public transport and housing.
ex.zh: 城市快速扩张的一个严重后果是公共交通和住房承受的压力增大。

tip: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。

senses.en: to leave or give up
To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished.
A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.

ex.en: We had to abandon the plan after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后我们不得不放弃那个计划。

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

tip: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。
